name: Apple Secure Transport 'goto fail'
defect: A duplicated `goto fail;` skips the signature comparison, so every handshake is accepted. The study models the defect's OBSERVABLE with one C source (src/sslcheck.c) built twice: the clean verifier compares the record's signature against its data's checksum and refuses mismatches; the -DGO_TO_FAIL build carries the duplicated goto and accepts everything. The record carries a `len=` field — the TLS record header's length — so the payload length is a first-class, minimizable dimension.

build.recipe: build/build.sh (BYTE-REPRODUCIBLE: the two verifiers are built inside a digest-pinned builder image — fedora:41 by OCI digest + exact gcc/binutils/glibc-devel NEVRAs, build/Containerfile — with the flags recorded in build/build-manifest.json)
build.official_tarballs: none — the defect shape is reproduced as a LOCAL SYNTHETIC MODEL (provenance_kind: synthetic-model in build/build-manifest.json; no upstream repository URL is claimed); the source is pinned by SHA-256 in build/build-manifest.json

verdict_study.comparator: comparators/tls-verdict.py (relation eq, extractor verdict-scan; did the side ACCEPT the record — a verdict is a semantic observable, never a byte diff)
verdict_study.minimizer: minimizers/record-length.py (kappa route ssl-handshake-minimize; reduces the declared payload length to the empirical floor 1)
verdict_study.mutation: mutations/signature-skip.py (operator signature-skip; proposes a verifier that accepts every record — the defect's observable shape, deterministic and synthetic)
verdict_study.minimal_trigger: a single-byte record with a wrong signature — the tls.handshake.record_data_length boundary: at length 1 the tampered-signature divergence survives, at length 0 the record is malformed (both sides refuse, no divergence). The typed adjacent-boundary is proven by the core's own two observations, with the domain projection (len=, embedded-integer) deriving both coordinates from the executed fixtures
verdict_study.evidence: evidence/ (regenerated by study.sh / reproduce.sh run; deterministic content-addressed ids)

challenge: signature-skip (the sensitivity proof: a court that never sees a skipped signature check cannot certify 'no acceptance of tampered records')

clean_control.expectation: no residual on the tls.verdict axis (with the valid record, both verifiers accept)
